commands: git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller && git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ab1ea38ad482f508c490a37e3e8a5fcf01e852c6" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

git fetch -q origin agent-control && git show FETCH_HEAD:.agent/scripts/20260911-fresh-chat-bootstrap-v1.py > /tmp/fresh-chat-bootstrap.py && python3 /tmp/fresh-chat-bootstrap.py && git diff --check && test "$(git diff --name-only | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = "AGENTS.md docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md docs/FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP.md "

grep -Fq 'Minimal fresh-chat resume command' AGENTS.md && grep -Fq 'sprawdz w jakim miejscu jestesmy, napisz krotkie podsumowanie i kontynuujmy dalsza prace nad kodem' AGENTS.md && grep -Fq 'Fresh chat bootstrap' docs/FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP.md && grep -Fq 'Minimal operator resume command' docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md && git add AGENTS.md docs/FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP.md docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md && git commit -m 'Add minimal fresh-chat resume contract' && git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller && echo FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP_PASS
